root_cause.provenance: Multisim default (all 40 analysis blocks in the .ms14 carry MAX_POINTS:long{128000})
root_cause.arithmetic_proof: 128000 points x 1.00806 ns = 129.03 us  -> matches the observed failure at ~120 us
root_cause.why_1.00806ns: engine forces TMAX = 1/(31 MHz)/32 = 1.00806 ns regardless of the user's TMAX, i.e. ~992000 points per simulated second
